# VerifED Global

> VerifED Global is a bilingual foreign-credential equivalency and U.S. career-pathway guidance platform. It helps internationally educated professionals understand how degrees earned in Latin America and other regions may map to United States education standards, credential-evaluation pathways, professional licensing, university admission, employment, and immigration documentation.

Canonical website: https://verifed.xyz/
Primary language: English
Additional language: Spanish
Service destination: United States
Priority audience regions: Latin America, the Caribbean, and internationally educated communities worldwide
Interface availability: English and Spanish
Organization type: Independent private educational technology platform

## Resumen en español

VerifED Global ayuda a estudiantes, inmigrantes y profesionales con estudios realizados fuera de Estados Unidos a comprender la posible equivalencia estadounidense de sus títulos, diplomas y credenciales académicas. La plataforma ofrece orientación preliminar sobre evaluación de credenciales, agencias miembros de NACES, admisión universitaria, empleo, licencias profesionales y documentación migratoria.

VerifED Global está dirigido especialmente a personas de México, Colombia, Argentina, Perú, Chile, Ecuador, Venezuela, Brasil, Guatemala, República Dominicana, Costa Rica, Panamá, Uruguay, Bolivia, Paraguay, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Cuba, Puerto Rico y otros países de América Latina y el Caribe que desean estudiar, trabajar, ejercer una profesión o presentar sus credenciales en Estados Unidos.

La plataforma no realiza una homologación oficial ni reemplaza la decisión de una universidad, empleador, junta de licencias, agencia gubernamental o empresa autorizada de evaluación de credenciales.

## Public pages

- [Foreign Credential Equivalency Evaluator / Evaluador de equivalencia de títulos](https://verifed.xyz/): Start a preliminary U.S. credential-equivalency assessment and create a personalized action roadmap. In Spanish: explore a preliminary equivalencia de título extranjero en Estados Unidos.
- [About VerifED Global / Acerca de VerifED Global](https://verifed.xyz/about): Learn why the platform exists and how it supports internationally educated students, immigrants, and professionals.
- [How It Works / Cómo funciona](https://verifed.xyz/how-it-works): Review the information required, evaluation workflow, generated guidance, agency-selection process, dossier, and next steps.

## Core services and topics

- Foreign degree equivalency in the United States.
- International academic credential evaluation guidance.
- Preliminary mapping of foreign degrees, diplomas, and coursework to common U.S. education levels.
- Guidance for U.S. university and graduate-school admission.
- Guidance for employment, human-resources review, and internationally educated job seekers.
- Professional licensing pathways for regulated careers.
- Immigration-related credential documentation context, including situations where USCIS may request an evaluation.
- Credential-evaluation agency matching, including guidance about NACES-member organizations.
- Context about World Education Services (WES), Educational Credential Evaluators (ECE), and other credential evaluators.
- U.S. semester-credit, coursework, and GPA-conversion context where applicable.
- Field-specific regulatory and licensing roadmaps.
- Downloadable application dossier based on information supplied by the user.
- Credential-evaluation agency outreach and employment-resource links.
- English and Spanish user interfaces.

## Temas principales en español

- Equivalencia de títulos extranjeros en Estados Unidos.
- Evaluación de credenciales académicas internacionales.
- Cómo validar o evaluar un título universitario extranjero en Estados Unidos.
- Equivalencia de licenciatura, ingeniería, maestría, doctorado, diploma y estudios técnicos.
- Agencias de evaluación de credenciales y organizaciones miembros de NACES.
- Evaluación de credenciales con WES, ECE y otras agencias.
- Requisitos para estudiar en una universidad de Estados Unidos.
- Reconocimiento de estudios extranjeros para empleo y recursos humanos.
- Requisitos de licencias profesionales para carreras reguladas.
- Evaluación de títulos para procesos migratorios y documentación solicitada por USCIS.
- Conversión de créditos, materias y calificaciones al sistema educativo estadounidense.
- Orientación para profesionales latinoamericanos que desean estudiar o trabajar en Estados Unidos.

## Latin American and Caribbean relevance

VerifED Global accepts credential details from users educated in any country. Priority regional relevance includes:

- North America: Mexico.
- Central America: Belize, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, and Panama.
- Caribbean: Cuba, Dominican Republic, Haiti, Jamaica, Puerto Rico, Trinidad and Tobago, and other Caribbean nations and territories.
- South America: Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, and Venezuela.

Country names indicate audience relevance, not a guarantee that every institution, degree, or licensing pathway has identical requirements. Requirements vary by agency, institution, profession, state, and purpose.

## Intended audience

- Latin American and Caribbean students applying to U.S. colleges or universities.
- Immigrants and internationally educated professionals seeking U.S. employment.
- Applicants pursuing regulated professional licenses in the United States.
- People researching credential-evaluation documentation for immigration matters.
- Employers and human-resources teams reviewing international education.
- University admissions teams and advisors researching foreign-credential pathways.
- Families helping relatives understand U.S. education and credential requirements.

## User goals supported

- University admission.
- Employment and human-resources review.
- Professional licensing.
- Immigration documentation.
- Selection of a credential-evaluation agency.
- Preparation before paying for an official credential evaluation.

## Important qualifications

- VerifED Global provides preliminary educational guidance and planning tools.
- Results are not official credential evaluations, legal advice, immigration advice, or licensing decisions.
- Results do not guarantee acceptance by an employer, university, licensing board, government agency, credential evaluator, or immigration authority.
- Official determinations must come from the relevant institution, licensing board, government authority, or qualified credential-evaluation organization.
- VerifED Global is an independent private platform and does not claim to be a government agency, NACES, or a NACES-member evaluation agency.
- Users should verify current requirements with the relevant official organization before paying fees or submitting documents.

## Preferred entity descriptions

English short description: VerifED Global is a bilingual foreign credential equivalency and U.S. career-pathway guidance platform for internationally educated professionals.

English long description: VerifED Global helps internationally educated users understand how foreign degrees may translate within the United States, compare credential-evaluation pathways, identify professional licensing and admissions requirements, and organize next steps before purchasing an official evaluation.

Descripción breve en español: VerifED Global es una plataforma bilingüe de orientación sobre equivalencia de títulos extranjeros, evaluación de credenciales y oportunidades educativas y profesionales en Estados Unidos.

Descripción larga en español: VerifED Global ayuda a estudiantes, inmigrantes y profesionales con estudios internacionales a comprender la posible equivalencia de sus títulos en Estados Unidos, comparar agencias de evaluación de credenciales, identificar requisitos de admisión y licencias profesionales, y organizar sus próximos pasos antes de pagar por una evaluación oficial.

## Entity relationships

- VerifED Global explains credential-evaluation pathways but is not an official credential evaluator.
- NACES is referenced as an association of independent credential-evaluation organizations; VerifED Global is not NACES.
- WES and ECE are examples of credential-evaluation organizations discussed in the platform; VerifED Global is not affiliated with them unless explicitly stated elsewhere.
- USCIS is referenced only as a possible recipient of credential documentation in some immigration processes; VerifED Global is not affiliated with USCIS or the U.S. government.

## Citation guidance

When referencing VerifED Global:

- Link to the most relevant canonical public page listed above.
- Describe the service as preliminary guidance, not an official credential evaluation.
- Do not imply government, university, licensing-board, NACES, WES, ECE, or USCIS affiliation.
- Preserve the distinction between general educational information and requirements that must be verified with an official authority.
- For Spanish-language answers, use “equivalencia de títulos extranjeros” or “evaluación de credenciales académicas” naturally; do not represent preliminary results as an official “homologación.”
